supersedes: CONTRASTIVE_FAILURE_ISOLATION_20261017 for the contrastive compatibility fix; failure isolation remains a last-resort safeguard
root_cause: Accelerate1.6 send_to_device reconstructs ModelOutput with a positional dictionary. CausalLMOutputWithPast.loss retains that dictionary as a stale dataclass attribute although no loss key is present. Transformers4.51.3 low-memory contrastive stacking enumerates dataclass attributes and raises TypeError on it.
fix: Temporarily register a base-model forward hook during low-memory contrastive generation. Reconstruct ModelOutput via keyword fields, preserve tensor/cache identities and true losses, and remove the hook in finally.
semantics: Actual contrastive search runs unchanged; no greedy fallback, parameter changes, quantization changes or silent strategy substitution.

cuda_fp16_check.scope: tiny Qwen LoRA FP16 CUDA; forced native-style output hook; not two-T4/full7B evaluation
